_comment: Gundam Universal Century manual watch order, drafted 2026-09-12. Supersedes the SmartLists version (IMDb list ls560971030, 'Gundam: Continuity Order') because that external list is missing two legitimate UC entries that need mid-sequence placement no external-list provider can express (same limitation as Trigun/Votoms/.hack/Steins;Gate, see README): (1) 'Mobile Suit Gundam: Cucuruz Doan's Island' (2022) -- a theatrical remake/expansion of TV episode 15, set UC 0079, slotted here right after that episode; (2) 'G-Saviour' (2000) -- live-action UC 0223 TV movie, the timeline's chronological endpoint, appended after Victory Gundam. IGLOO trilogy internal order corrected from release order to in-story chronology per Gundam Wiki/community sourcing (2026-09-12 session): Hidden One Year War (early war) -> Gravity Front (Battle of Odessa, mid-war) -> Apocalypse 0079 (final month, Solomon/A Baoa Qu) -- NOT release order, which is Hidden One Year War / Apocalypse 0079 / Gravity Front. DO NOT RUN until all 13 pending Jellyseerr requests (11 originally missing UC titles + Doan's Island + G-Saviour, requested 2026-09-12) finish importing -- build_playlist.py errors out on any title not yet present in Jellyfin. Series/movie 'name' values below are placeholders using common English titles; verify each against the exact Jellyfin library Name once imported (Sonarr/Radarr import naming can differ, e.g. punctuation or subtitle placement) before running -- exact-match lookup in build_playlist.py will fail silently loud (SystemExit) on any mismatch, which is the cue to fix the title string here, not to guess further.
